column1: # Dual-OTA layout for 4MB flash: two app slots (firmware OTA) + LittleFS (blocklist).
# LittleFS is 1.375MB raw (~1.36MB usable). The blocklist swap stages the
# replacement next to the live file
# blocklist OTA realistically tops out around ~115-120k domains at 5 bytes
# each + 128KB bloom. Bigger lists: use the single-app variant
